topic_clusters.title: AI Medical Scheduling
topic_clusters.summary: AI-driven scheduling systems are reducing no-show rates through natural language interactions and capturing patient intent.
topic_clusters.observation: These systems are being widely adopted in healthcare settings to improve efficiency and reduce financial losses.

all_evidence.excerpt: The payoff is measured in no-shows: missed appointments cost the U.S. healthcare system an estimated $150 billion a year, and conversational scheduling routinely cuts no-show rates by 30-40% by capturing intent up front and rescheduling patients inside the reminder itself.
